description: This file defines mixins for creating various gradient backgrounds in LESS, including horizontal, vertical, directional, three-color, radial, and striped gradients. It is used to generate CSS gradient styles with cross-browser support.
external_files: ms filters for older IE versions

methods.name: horizontal
methods.description: Creates a horizontal gradient from a start color to an end color with specified percentages.

methods.name: vertical
methods.description: Creates a vertical gradient from a start color to an end color with specified percentages.

methods.name: directional
methods.description: Creates a gradient at an angle with specified start and end colors.

methods.name: horizontal-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a horizontal gradient with three colors and a color stop position.

methods.name: vertical-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a vertical gradient with three colors and a color stop position.

methods.name: radial
methods.description: Creates a radial gradient with inner and outer colors.

methods.name: striped
methods.description: Creates a striped pattern gradient with specified angle and color.
